head.h1: Kids' Nutrition Chef Catering in Dubai — Prices, Formats and What You Get

opening_paragraph: A kids nutrition chef catering dubai booking from myCHEF puts a vetted private chef in your kitchen cooking balanced, genuinely kid-friendly meals, from AED 700 per person. Your chef builds the menu around what your children will happily eat, then handles the shopping, the cooking, the service and the clear-up, and works around allergies and fussy eaters. Getting a child to eat well should not be a nightly battle. Tell us your dates and household and we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with an itemised proposal to follow.
Note: We focus on balanced, wholesome, everyday meals; we do not provide medical or clinical dietetic advice.

new_paragraphs: The menu is built around your children, not a fixed list. Typical everyday options include wholegrain pasta with hidden-veg sauces, grilled fish fingers with sweet-potato wedges, chicken and vegetable stir-fries, homemade soups, and lunchboxes for school. Breakfasts run from overnight oats and fruit to eggs and wholegrain toast; snacks lean on yoghurt, hummus, fresh fruit and home-baked oat bars. For a gathering, the chef scales the same ideas into a shareable spread of finger food the whole group can graze on. Everything is seasoned gently, low on added sugar and salt, and portioned for small appetites. If your family follows a particular way of eating, the menu flexes: see our healthy catering options or a structured weekly meal-prep plan for consistent, batch-cooked meals through the week.

add_block.new_heading: What does a kids' nutrition chef include?
new_paragraphs: It includes everything from planning the meals to washing up — one private chef and caterer handles the whole cycle so you do not have to. Your chef starts with a short conversation about your children's ages, likes, dislikes and any allergies, then designs balanced meals with protein, vegetables and slow-release carbohydrates presented in a way kids genuinely want to eat. On the day, they bring the plan to life: market-fresh shopping, cooking in your own kitchen, portioning for each child, and leaving the space cleaner than they found it. Because it all happens in your home, this can be a one-off dinner, a weekend of family meals, or a recurring weekly rhythm. And because everything is cooked in front of you, you see exactly what goes into each plate — no hidden sugar, no mystery ingredients, just wholesome food your household can trust.

add_block.new_heading: Kids' nutrition catering for birthdays, parties & family events
new_paragraphs: Yes — the same chef who cooks balanced weekday dinners also handles party catering for birthdays, playdates and family gatherings. For a children's birthday, that means colourful, healthier versions of the party favourites: baked chicken tenders, veggie-loaded mini pizzas, fruit skewers and naturally-sweetened treats that look fun without a sugar crash to follow. For mixed family events, the chef plates food the adults enjoy alongside a dedicated kids' spread, so nobody is stuck negotiating. We also cater at villas, garden parties and community spaces, and even at corporate family days and office open-houses where employees bring their children. Whether it is six kids or sixty, the food stays balanced, the presentation stays playful, and the parents get a break.

new_paragraphs: Allergies and fussy eating are handled up front, not left to chance. Before cooking, your chef confirms every allergy and intolerance in the household and prepares nut-free, gluten-free, dairy-free or egg-free meals with careful separation to avoid cross-contact. For picky eaters, the approach is gradual and practical: familiar shapes and textures first, vegetables introduced in ways children accept, and small wins built over repeat visits. The chef can also align meals with a child's sport or activity schedule, keeping energy steady across the day. Parents who want portioned, ready-to-heat food during busy weeks can pair this with meal prep, so healthy choices are on hand whenever the week gets hectic. What we do not do is diagnose or prescribe — for any medical condition, we work alongside your paediatrician or dietitian instead of replacing them.
